subject: Pause on open reqs + reallocation plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Company-wide pause on new reqs; immediate ask for reallocation plan

Markus / Laura —

Finance sent a short note this morning putting in a temporary freeze on posting any new requisitions and on extending new offers outside of previously approved offer windows. Leadership wants a quick recalibration of Q1 hiring to hit the revised spend profile.

Action requested from your orgs: please provide a 72-hour plan (due Mon 2/22 EOD) that includes:
- A prioritized list of open reqs (role, current stage, hiring owner)
- Which reqs are critical (must-fill) vs. deferrable or re-scope-able
- Any offers currently in-flight and their deadlines
- Suggested headcount reallocation (from less critical teams to critical projects)

I attached the headcount snapshot and the export of pending offers I pulled from Greenhouse. If you need an exemption for an urgent hire, include business impact + cost to delay.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Q1_headcount_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: pending_offers_list.csv (CSV)

From: Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>
To: People Leaders <people-leaders@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 06:50:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term hiring pause to align with revised forecast

Team —

We need to pause new reqs and offers effective immediately while we align to the updated Q1 forecast. This is expected to be in place for ~2–3 weeks but may be adjusted. Please prepare prioritized lists and escalation cases for any hires you consider mission-critical.

Thanks,
Finance Ops
